$comment: High or critical advisories the runtime dependency audit lets through (scripts/check-audit.mjs). Each entry names one advisory by ID (never a package), says why it does not reach users, and expires: past that date the audit fails, so renewing is a deliberate change. An entry the audit no longer reports also fails, so remove it once upstream ships a fix.

advisories.reason: ReDoS on crafted glob patterns, no patched version yet. It comes in through @wxt-dev/i18n's build-time module (tinyglobby) and wxt/vite, and only matches the project's own globs during the build; the extension package contains no picomatch or tinyglobby code. Re-check the build output before renewing.
